name: herma
summary: Herma: context-shimming AI middleware for configurable coding harnesses — intercepts requests via keyword, semantic, or micromodel rules to respond directly or shim atomic noun, verb, and URI context from a user-configured database before LLM execution. Rules and atomic noun/verb entries load from SQLite/D1 (context_entries), Tessera stores and blobs, or remote handshake servers; generic consumer chat assistants and contributor-tier models are deterministically refused.

status.notes: Schemas (Provision shim_context/respond_directly + ContextEntry noun/verb/detail), configurable-harness gate, 3-tier trigger engine, SQLite/D1/Tessera/remote-handshake provision and context database, multi-protocol context shimming and zero-token direct responses (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses, /v1/messages, /v1/dry-run), FastAPI service, CLI, and Cloudflare Worker + D1 edge built and verified.

components.title: RFC 9457 error hierarchy
components.role: Maps typed middleware, scope, harness, and contributor-tier refusals to deterministic HTTP statuses

components.title: Provision, context-entry, trigger, key, and receipt schemas
components.role: Strict Pydantic models for provisions (shim_context/respond_directly), atomic noun/verb/detail context entries, URIs, 3-tier triggers, harness keys, and SHA-256 receipts

components.title: Configurable-harness access gate
components.role: Verifies constant-time hmk_ secrets, enforces route/configure scopes, refuses generic consumer chat surfaces, and blocks -contributor models

components.title: Three-tier trigger engine
components.role: Evaluates Tier-1 keyword/regex/path/tool, Tier-2 semantic cosine, and Tier-3 micromodel classifier triggers with short-circuiting

components.title: Provision & atomic noun/verb context database + sync adapters
components.role: SQLite WAL store for provisions and context_entries (noun/verb/detail), SHA-256 harness keys, receipts, Tessera CAS/blob/noun-verb sync, and remote handshake sync

components.title: Multi-protocol context shimmer, direct-response builder & receipt minter
components.role: Extracts prompt/path/tool signals across chat_completions, responses, and messages, shims rules + URIs + [NOUN/VERB CONTEXT] or builds direct responses, deduplicates turns, and mints SHA-256 receipts

components.title: Direct-response short-circuit & upstream forwarding engine
components.role: Evaluates active provisions, short-circuits respond_directly rules into protocol-faithful completions, or forwards shimmed payloads (JSON or SSE) to allowlisted upstream LLM endpoints

components.title: FastAPI HTTP service, context API, and read-only console
components.role: Serves proxy, /v1/context noun/verb database, and provision-sync endpoints behind HERMA_EDGE_SECRET lockdown plus read-only HTML overview/connect pages

components.title: Command-line interface and end-to-end demo
components.role: Provides seed, keys, context, dry-run, 3-tier Tessera-synced context-shim + direct-response demo, and serve commands

components.title: Cloud Worker & Edge
components.role: 24/7 native Cloudflare Worker + D1 (ta-amps-herma, auto-creating context_entries) + Tessera Cloud Service Binding running 3-tier trigger evaluation, noun/verb context shimming, direct responses, and receipt persistence

invariants.statement: Generic consumer chat assistants, browser navigation requests, and cookie-authenticated calls are deterministically refused
Provision management and remote sync require both configure scope and explicit matching X-Herma-Harness attestation
Contributor-tier models (-contributor) are refused across outbound LLM payloads and micromodel trigger classifiers
Tier-1 keyword, bounded regex, path-glob, and tool-name triggers match deterministically without network calls
Tier-2 semantic triggers match paraphrased intent without literal keyword overlap
Tier-1 or Tier-2 hits short-circuit Tier-3 micromodel calls when trigger mode is any
Compare-and-set versions prevent silent provision overwrites, Tessera blob URIs resolve deterministically, and remote handshakes clamp max_chars
Multi-turn conversations deduplicate once_per_conversation provisions and HERMA_EDGE_SECRET blocks direct origin traffic lacking x-edge-auth
Matched context_refs shim bounded atomic noun, verb, and detail entries from context_entries or Tessera stores and record shimmed_context_refs in the receipt
Provisions with action=respond_directly return protocol-faithful completions across chat_completions, responses, and messages without invoking upstream LLM transport while recording a SHA-256 receipt

import_rules.why: Ring 0 holds pure schemas, error contracts, and stateless harness access gates with zero I/O
Core trigger, store, and injection engines never depend on FastAPI or CLI entry points
Runtime package code never imports test, build, or deployment folders

claims.claim: Herma evaluates keyword, semantic, and micromodel triggers to shim versioned provisions and URIs across chat_completions, responses, and messages while refusing generic consumer assistants
Herma loads and syncs versioned provisions and atomic noun/verb context entries from Tessera CAS/blob/noun stores and remote handshake servers
Herma shims atomic noun, verb, and detail context from a user-configured database or responds directly across all 3 LLM wire protocols with zero upstream token spend
